profile_definition.title: Commercial service launch
profile_definition.description: A first commercial launch, or a new service within an existing business.
profile_definition.status_note: Pilot checklist. It is self-reviewed and is not a compliance certificate: it does not claim to list every requirement that applies to you.

wording.ready: Prepared for the defined launch scope against this checklist.
wording.not_ready: Not prepared yet for the defined launch scope.
wording.insufficient_evidence: Not enough evidence to assess yet.
wording.disclaimer: This measures preparation for the launch you defined. It does not guarantee demand, profit, regulatory compliance or survival.

checks.label: Target segment, problem and dated demand evidence are documented
checks.missing: Describe your target customer and their problem, and attach dated demand evidence.

checks.label: Evidence relevance and limitations are explicitly reviewed
checks.missing: Confirm you have reviewed how relevant the evidence is and what it does not show.

checks.label: Launch scope, price, delivery terms and customer promise are confirmed
checks.missing: Fill in what you are launching, the price, delivery terms and your promise to the customer, then confirm them.

checks.label: Cost and margin inputs are validated and their implications reviewed
checks.missing: Enter price and costs, then confirm you have reviewed what the margin means.

checks.label: The required cash projection is complete and reconciled
checks.missing: Complete the cash projection for every month it must cover.

checks.label: Setup and operating commitments are included with evidence or labelled as assumptions
checks.missing: List your setup and operating commitments, each marked as evidenced or an assumption.

checks.label: Planned demand fits evidenced available capacity
checks.missing: Enter your available capacity, what is already committed and what the launch needs.

checks.label: Critical suppliers, people and systems are available, with contingency where needed
checks.missing: List the suppliers, people and systems you depend on, and whether each is available.

checks.label: The enquiry or order to delivery and payment process is documented
checks.missing: Describe how an enquiry or order becomes a delivery and a payment.

checks.label: A representative end-to-end dry run has recorded results and resolved critical failures
checks.missing: Record an end-to-end test run and what happened.

checks.label: Applicable launch obligations and prerequisites are identified and reviewed
checks.missing: List what you must have in place to launch, then confirm you have reviewed which apply.

checks.label: Required permissions or prerequisites are evidenced as completed by launch
checks.missing: Mark each prerequisite completed, with its evidence, before launch.

checks.label: Initial acquisition channel, audience and launch message are defined
checks.missing: Name your first channel, its audience and your launch message.

checks.label: Channel execution has an owner, budget and measurable target
checks.missing: Give the channel an owner, a budget and a target.

checks.label: Launch milestones, date and owners are agreed
checks.missing: Set the launch date and give every milestone a date and an owner.

checks.label: Success measures, incident response and post-launch review date are recorded
checks.missing: Record how you will measure success, what you do if something goes wrong and when you will review.

gates.label: No cash shortfall in the months the projection must cover
gates.remedy: Change the plan so cash stays above zero in every month, or add committed, evidenced financing. Expected funding is not enough.

gates.label: Planned demand fits confirmed delivery capacity
gates.remedy: Reduce the launch volume, or add capacity that is confirmed available by the launch date.

gates.label: Every required permission or prerequisite is completed and valid at launch
gates.remedy: Complete the prerequisite and attach its evidence. A permission must still be valid on the launch date.

gates.label: The end-to-end delivery and payment test has no unresolved critical failure
gates.remedy: Resolve the failure, run the test again and record the result.

gates.label: Each sale contributes more than it costs to deliver
gates.remedy: Raise the price or lower the cost of delivery until the contribution is above zero.

fields.label: What problem does it solve for them?
I confirm the scope, price, terms and promise
Fixed costs each month
fields.help: For a new service in an existing business, enter only the costs the launch adds.

fields.label: How shared costs are split
fields.help: Only for a new service that shares costs with the rest of the business.

fields.label: Measured in
fields.help: For example hours, customers or projects.

fields.label: Capacity used by one unit of volume
fields.help: Only needed when volume and capacity use different units, for example hours per customer.

fields.label: The launch does not depend on any critical supplier, person or system
How does an enquiry or order become a delivery and a payment?
Process version
fields.help: Change this when the process changes. A test run only counts for the version it tested.

fields.label: Every critical failure has been resolved
What must be in place to launch
Nothing has to be in place before this launch
Channel target
fields.help: For example 20 enquiries in the first month.
